name: Tsuguhara Towa
source:
The miko of the Marenis religion.
Mikos have been sickly for generations, but are born with the power to receive divine revelations.

"I had a dream that I would meet all of you here today."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=17]official website[/url]]
